Function.message: Use a typed signature like `(arg: T) => R` instead of `Function`.

Object.message: Use `Record<string, unknown>` or a concrete shape instead of `Object`.

{}.message: Use `Record<string, unknown>`, `object`, or a concrete shape instead of `{}`.

patterns.message: Cross-package relative imports are forbidden. Import via the @atlas/<pkg> alias.
postgres.js is confined to @atlas/adapter-node. Use ports + the createNodeAdapters factory instead.
nodemailer is confined to @atlas/adapter-node. Apps must reach SMTP through the Mailer port (constructed via createMailer in bootstrap).
